note: Standard profiles are not exhaustive because custom prefixed profiles are allowed.
Company prefix validation requires a project registry.
Validate the complete VSA_LINEAR implementation element structure.
Validate the complete VSA_SQUARE implementation aggregation chain.
Validate the complete VSA_RECTANGULAR implementation aggregation chain.
Validate alternating STRUCTURE/ARRAY chain and terminal semantics for VSA_FULLY_FLEXIBLE.
Nonterminal VSA implementation elements cannot be TYPE_REFERENCE.
Mapped application profile with absent implementation profile requires STRUCTURE implementation type.
Variable-size array implementation is STRUCTURE with exactly two role-specific subElements.
For mapped LINEAR/SQUARE/FULLY_FLEXIBLE profiles, first subelement is sufficiently large integer Size Indicator.
Implementation-only LINEAR/SQUARE/FULLY_FLEXIBLE profile requires a sufficient integer first subelement.
Mapped RECTANGULAR first subelement is ARRAY sized to dimension count.
Implementation-only RECTANGULAR first subelement is ARRAY sized to rectangular dimension count.
Every rectangular Size Indicator element is an integer large enough for maxArraySize.
Mapped profile second subelement is ARRAY with all application dimensions and corresponding maxArraySize.
Implementation-only profile requires second subelement category ARRAY.
targetCategory is TYPE_REFERENCE/FUNCTION_REFERENCE, with VALUE only for void base type.
Forbid nested DATA_REFERENCE pointer-to-pointer construction.
ImplementationDataType SwDataDefProps selects exactly one of baseType, swPointerTargetProps, or implementationDataType.
Missing nativeDeclaration requires the implementation type shortName to match the external AUTOSAR Platform/Standard Type catalog.
Portability recommendation for integral C symbols.
SwBaseType.category is FIXED_LENGTH or VARIABLE_LENGTH.
FIXED_LENGTH requires baseTypeSize and forbids maxBaseTypeSize.
VARIABLE_LENGTH requires maxBaseTypeSize and forbids baseTypeSize.
Validate supported baseTypeEncoding values and BOOLEAN's associated two-scale TEXTTABLE semantics.
UTF-16 requires byteOrder in the two allowed byte-order values.
